interpretation.explicitly_establishes: Supplied research paraphrase, pending verification: France-Visas says previous biometric data may be reused where a previous biometric Schengen visa was issued less than 59 months ago. It separately describes possible personal-appearance exemption where fingerprints were collected for a previous visa application less than 59 months before the current application.
interpretation.does_not_establish: Less than 59 months is strict, not five years or 60 months. Visa issue date and biometric capture date are different reference facts, not interchangeable; reuse is not guaranteed.
